summary: Prioritize AI use cases, assess readiness, and shape a governed investment roadmap. Explore this practical five-day course.
lede: AI strategy training helps digital, data, technology, and business leaders evaluate investment proposals and plan feasible implementation. They assess readiness, prioritize use cases by value, feasibility, risk, and strategic fit, map data and infrastructure dependencies, compare sourcing options, and develop governance controls, risk ownership, pilot measures, and roadmap milestones for accountable decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals shaping AI investment choices, delivery conditions, and governance across emerging-market operating environments. It suits intermediate-level practitioners who contribute to AI initiatives or need to evaluate proposals and report their implications.
modules: OECD AI Principles and Market Context
AI Investment Roadmap and Value Reporting
prerequisites: Recommended: working familiarity with organizational strategy, digital or data initiatives, and basic AI terminology. No coding or programming is required for the course exercises.
topics: Data science & machine learning in practice
